API ReferenceBusiness Insights APICustom ApplicationsUpdate a Custom App
Update a Custom App
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/bi/api/v1/customapps/:id

This endpoint updates a custom application.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
int32
REQUIRED

ID of the custom application to update.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
name
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: <= 128 characters

Example: Salesforce CRM
description
string
REQUIRED

Description of the custom application. Cannot contain < or > characters.

Possible values: <= 1024 characters

Example: Tracks all Salesforce CRM traffic
signatures
object[]
REQUIRED
Examples
Update name and add a HOST signature
Responses
​
200
400
401
403
405
415
429
500

Custom application updated successfully.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
default
SCHEMA
id
int32
Example: 101
name
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: <= 128 characters

Example: Salesforce CRM
associatedAppName
string

Associated application name (server-assigned).

Example: Salesforce
associatedAppCategory
string

Associated application category (server-assigned).

Example: CRM
description
string
REQUIRED

Description of the custom application. Cannot contain < or > characters.

Possible values: <= 1024 characters

Example: Tracks all Salesforce CRM traffic
signatures
object[]
REQUIRED
